name: counter
prompt: Write an RTXUI app with a counter. The screen shows the text `Count: N`, where N starts at 0. The first focusable element is a button labelled `Increment` that adds one; the second is a button labelled `Reset` that sets N back to 0.

name: todo
prompt: Write an RTXUI todo list. The first focusable element is a text input; the second is a button labelled `Add` that appends the input's text to a list shown below and clears the input. Each item is shown on its own line prefixed with `- `. Above the list, show `Items: N` with the number of items.

name: filter
prompt: Write an RTXUI app showing the fruits Apple, Banana, Cherry and Mango, one per line. The first focusable element is a text input; only fruits whose name contains the typed text (case-insensitive) are listed. Below the list, show `Shown: N` with the number of fruits listed.

name: settings
prompt: Write an RTXUI settings form with two checkboxes, labelled `Dark mode` and `Notifications`, both unchecked at first. Below them, show a status line `Dark mode: on` or `Dark mode: off`, and another `Notifications: on` or `Notifications: off`, following the checkboxes. The checkboxes are the first and second focusable elements.

name: layout
prompt: Write an RTXUI app laid out like a classic application window: a header row containing the title `My App`, a body split into a left sidebar (about a quarter of the width, listing `Home`, `Files` and `Settings`) and a main area showing `Welcome`, and a footer row showing `Status: ready`. Draw a rounded border around the whole window.
